name: Marie François Xavier Bichat
summary: French anatomist and physiologist who pioneered tissue theory and pathological anatomy without microscopy.

name: Marc-Antoine Petit
summary: Distinguished surgeon who mentored Bichat in Lyon.

name: Pierre-Joseph Desault
summary: Surgeon and anatomist who mentored Bichat at Hôtel-Dieu hospital in Paris.

name: Jean-Nicolas Corvisart
summary: Physician to Napoleon Bonaparte who commented on Bichat's death.

name: René Laennec
summary: Inventor of the stethoscope who was directly inspired by Bichat's method.

name: Rudolf Virchow
summary: Father of modern pathology who extended Bichat's insights to the cellular level.

name: Thoirette
summary: Small town in France where Bichat was born.

name: France
summary: Country where Bichat lived and worked.

name: Medical School of Montpellier
summary: Renowned medical school where Bichat's father received training.

name: Lyon
summary: City where Bichat pursued formal medical education.

name: Paris
summary: City where Bichat moved in 1793 to work at Hôtel-Dieu.

name: Hôtel-Dieu
summary: Prestigious hospital in Paris where Bichat worked and died.

name: Traité des membranes
summary: Pioneering study of the structure and function of membranes published by Bichat.

name: Recherches physiologiques sur la vie et la mort
summary: Physiological exploration of the nature of life and death published by Bichat.

name: Anatomie générale appliquée à la physiologie et à la médecine
summary: Methodologically important text categorizing tissues as primary anatomical units.

name: Anatomie descriptive
summary: Comprehensive account of human body structure organized by tissue types.

name: Oeuvres chirurgicales de Desault
summary: Surgical works of Desault completed and published by Bichat.
